about: Unsatisfiability certificates of the proofs. 'stored' files are in certificates/ of this directory and are listed in MANIFEST.sha256 of the repository; 'recreated' certificates are too large to store, and the given command, run from this directory, writes them again with the SHA-256 listed in the entry or in its sha256_file.

stored.what: LRAT proof (xz -9e) that the formula of the free-vertex case of (28, 6, 3, 2, 1) is unsatisfiable

recreated.what: (48, 9, 5, 0, 2), all 707 pivot orbits of both shapes: for the 541 orbits whose formula reaches the solver, the CNF, the DRAT proof by CaDiCaL 1.9.5 and the LRAT file by drat-trim, checked by drat-trim and the LRAT checker; the formulas of the other 166 orbits contain the empty clause
recreated.command: "$SOLVER_PYTHON" -X utf8 checks/search48_second.py search --kind KIND --solver cadical --part I/12 --proof-dir DIR --proof-orbits all --discard-proofs --drat-timeout 900
recreated.runs: 24 runs: KIND = C8 and 2C4, I = 0, ..., 11; 18895 s (5 h 15 min) on one thread in total. --discard-proofs removes the files of each orbit after its check; without it they stay in DIR

recreated.what: (28, 6, 3, 2, 1): the formula of the free-vertex case and of the case without free vertices with their DRAT proofs; written to a temporary folder, checked by drat-trim and the LRAT checker, then removed
